evidence_slice: Historic England's NHLE List Entry 1266928 identifies Exeter Grammar School, Victoria Park Road, Exeter, as a Grade II Listed Building and describes an L-shaped Gothic school block dating 1878-1880. Historic England's current NHLE Listed Building polygons FeatureServer layer 3 is an esriGeometryPolygon layer exposing ListEntry, Name and Grade fields and supports GeoJSON queries. In this source window, the exact query for ListEntry 1266928 could not be retrieved through the available web channel; a direct network attempt failed at DNS resolution before any response payload was received. Therefore no polygon coordinates were available and no footprint was inferred.
